name: Classic Waffles
desc: Crisp golden waffles made with warm milk, melted butter, and vanilla.

source.title: Classic Waffles
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (2 cups flour, 4 tsp baking powder, 1 1/2 cups warm milk, 1/3 cup melted butter, 2 eggs, vanilla), read through a BigOven copy of the Allrecipes recipe because allrecipes.com blocked direct reads.

ingredients.raw: Cooking spray, for the waffle iron

steps: Preheat the waffle iron. In a large bowl, mix the flour, salt, baking powder, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs, then stir in the warm milk, melted butter, and vanilla.
Pour the milk mixture into the flour mixture and beat until blended.
Coat the iron with cooking spray and ladle in batter (the amount your iron's manual recommends). Cook until golden and crisp and the iron stops steaming, 3 to 5 minutes. Serve immediately.
tips: Makes about 10 waffles. Hold finished waffles on a rack in a 200°F oven so they stay crisp while the rest cook.
